findings.failure_scenario: Pack golden legs pass with a missing golden. Outside CI, vitest's toMatchFileSnapshot writes a missing snapshot and passes. m18-complete tests() and the precommit ladder (verifyLeg sets CI='') both run without CI. Reproduced in a copy: deleting packs/basic/__golden__/star.svg gave 'Snapshots 1 written, Tests 4 passed'; with CI=1 the same run failed. A definition added without a golden turns the leg green locally. An orphan golden for a removed definition (extra __golden__/zzz.svg) is never noticed. Same at packs/basic/src/pack.test.ts:87, and it affects all 12 pack legs. Still true for packs/arrows (92e907e) and packs/callouts (2d6a63e): same toMatchFileSnapshot loop, no __golden__ inventory check (both pass 8/8 under CI=1 today).

M18.95 (0cca529) has no tracked digest line. Its commit added the M18.43 cp9 line instead, and the local verdict b1065f32...r1.json is gitignored. The commit says the reviewer's minor F1 is 'argued in the next commit', but review-argued.txt has no M18.95 line. This repeats cp9 F1 one checkpoint later: with four parallel streams and M18.99 (digest-coverage leg) still todo, nothing stops more uncovered task commits.

Plan item 6 is 'Iconify JSON collection import -> pack', but importIconifyLibrary only registers definitions in the runtime registry. It builds no pack index or credits from the retained provenance. prepareShapePacks rejects any used non-builtin ID that has no distribution or embedded source ('unresolved definition'), so a document using an imported icon cannot be saved portably, and the icon's ISC provenance never reaches the saved attribution (NFR-LIC-003). No todo row (M18.16, M18.17, M18.34) owns turning imported collections into a saveable credited pack.

Display names, the distribution version and credits exist only in each pack's test file (NAMES/DRAFT). The whole template (DRAFT, BRANDS regex, glob loader, four cases) is copied verbatim per pack, and ten more packs will copy it again. The runtime library takes names from entryOf(id), so it shows 'Or' and 'Off page connector' where pack/index.json says 'Or junction' and 'Off-page connector'. The index pins version 1.0.0 while the package VERSION is 0.0.0. Two sources of truth will drift as M18.22-31 land and M18.32 searches the index. M18.22 and M18.23 copied the template a third and fourth time (diff is NAMES plus pack id only).

Parallel streams disagree on the pack format. The ADR-0193 suite hard-codes formatVersion '1.0' and checks files through createShapePackLoader, which M18.95 made refuse 1.1. A first-party pack whose artwork binds an exact font (pack 1.1, ADR-0192) therefore cannot be built or checked by the shared suite. pack-files.ts also redefines problem() beside pack-bytes.ts problem() with a different return shape.

Spot mutant: deleting the maxFaces or maxTotalFontBytes checks in bindingsOf leaves artwork-pack-loader.test.ts green, because the test only asserts the constants (line 173). With one supported profile, one resource per hash and no two faces per resource in core, the checks are also unreachable. They are untested public limits (ARTWORK_ACQUISITION_LIMITS), and M18.95 review F1 was never recorded.
Done rows M18.95, M18.18, M18.20 and M18.21 have empty Commit cells again (cp9 F2 recurrence), so audits cannot map those rows to 0cca529, cd518e6, a615d21 and 367e343.

2d6a63e (M18.23, callouts row) changed the arrows quad head range, so the arrows straight category hash changed (7773da6a... to 2d791a4e...) while index version stayed 1.0.0. The changeset bumps @fluxion/pack-arrows patch, but the distribution version is hard-coded in the test DRAFT, so arrows@1.0.0 now names two different byte contents. A data lock (ADR-0183: id + exact version + integrity) saved against the earlier bytes would fail integrity against a host that ships the later bytes under the same version. The fix also landed in another row's commit.

The shared suite validates and draws each definition only at default params. M18.22 shipped four param-range geometry defects in r1 (chevron text region negative, quad/striped heads overlap, circular head leaves the box) and a fifth in r2 (quad barb narrower than the shaft below head 0.15). All were found by per-commit review, not tests; none of the fixes added a test, and the arrows goldens were unchanged. Callouts tail params ('kept inside the box') are likewise untested. Re-widening any range (mutant: quad head min back to 0.05) leaves every pack leg green, and nine param-heavy packs remain.
